system_summary: A two-tier service: an HTTP API over a domain core, with a small web client. One paragraph an agent reads first to orient — what the system is and how its parts relate.

subsystems.name: API
subsystems.summary: HTTP entry points and request orchestration over the domain core.
subsystems.basis: All three clusterings agree these share an import cluster and co-change together.

subsystems.name: Domain core
subsystems.summary: Business rules and persistence, independent of transport.
subsystems.basis: folder + depgraph clusterings; the engine and repository are the stable hub.

component_descriptions.go:internal/handlers: Maps HTTP requests to domain calls and shapes responses.
component_descriptions.go:cmd/server: Wires routes and dependencies and starts the listener (composition root).
component_descriptions.go:internal/engine: Evaluates the business rules over a loaded entity.
component_descriptions.go:internal/repository: Reads and writes entities; the only component that touches the database.

disagreements.finding: handlers and repository co-change in git history but have no static import between them — a hidden contract the import graph cannot show.
